name: Messenger
tagline: Facebook's chat app, being folded back into the Facebook app
facts: Not split; inside Meta FoA $60.4B Q2'26
Run within the Facebook app org (est.)
Win/Mac apps retired; messenger.com closed Apr 2026

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Meta: build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Messaging as the social layer of Facebook: discover content in feed, discuss it with friends in chat.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Re-merge with Facebook (inbox in app, web via facebook.com/messages), cut standalone surfaces, double down on mobile.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Facebook identity and friend graph, Marketplace buyer-seller chats, Pages inbox for millions of businesses.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Meta AI in chat and Business Agent automating Page and Marketplace conversations; E2EE by default since Dec 2023.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Messenger survive as a standalone app, or is it a feature of Facebook that Meta should fully absorb?

customers.pain: Want to chat with Facebook friends without sharing phone numbers
customers.why: Friends already on Facebook; no phone number needed; easy Reels and link sharing

customers.who: Buyers and sellers of used goods
customers.pain: Need quick, trusted negotiation with strangers about listings
customers.why: Chat is built into Marketplace with profile identity and listing context

customers.who: Admins of hobby, school, local groups
customers.pain: Need group coordination beyond feed posts
customers.why: Communities up to 5,000 members tied to Facebook groups

customers.who: SMBs answering Page and ad enquiries
customers.pain: Too many repetitive customer questions across channels
customers.why: Unified Meta inbox, automated replies, Business Agent handles bookings and sales

customers.pain: Need leads that turn into conversations
customers.why: Meta targeting plus conversational follow-up and sponsored messages to opted-in users

products.name: Chats and Calls
products.desc: E2EE 1:1 and group chat, voice and video calls

products.name: Communities
products.desc: Group spaces for up to 5,000 people

products.name: Meta AI in Messenger
products.desc: AI assistant, image generation, chat summaries

products.name: Facebook inbox
products.desc: Messenger inside Facebook app and facebook.com/messages

portfolio.north_star: Weekly users sending messages to Facebook friends
portfolio.key_metrics: DAU, messages per user, Reels shares to chat, call minutes
portfolio.guardrails: Scam message reports, chat-history restore failures, app uninstalls

products.name: Click-to-Messenger ads
products.desc: Facebook and Instagram ads that open a Messenger chat

products.name: Messenger Platform API
products.desc: APIs for bots and CRM integrations on Pages

products.name: Meta Business Agent
products.desc: AI agent answering, booking, selling across Meta apps

products.name: Sponsored messages
products.desc: Paid outbound messages to users who chatted before

portfolio.north_star: Business conversations resolved or converted per week
portfolio.key_metrics: Ad-initiated conversations, cost per conversation, agent resolution rate
portfolio.guardrails: Block/report rate on businesses, response time, Marketplace scam reports

rows.how: Auction CPC/CPM; optimised for conversations started

rows.who_uses: Users who previously messaged a Page
rows.how: Paid re-engagement messages via Ads Manager
Native ad units sold in Meta's unified ads auction
Business Agent free at launch; paid tier planned under Meta One

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: No disclosed figure; value is mostly indirect, lifting Facebook ad conversion via chat-based ads and Marketplace.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: ~950M users pay nothing; advertisers and businesses pay; monetisation is thin versus Facebook feed.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Shared Meta infrastructure keeps cost low; retiring desktop apps and messenger.com cuts maintenance overhead.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Deeper Facebook integration, content sharing in chat, Meta AI, paid Business Agent, Marketplace growth.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Unbundling (2014) built scale; rebundling (2024-26) shows a standalone app needs a unique job to justify itself.

friction: Desktop users forced onto facebook.com after shutdown
Phone-only users lost web access in 2026
E2EE chat-history PIN restore confuses users
Scam and spam message requests from strangers
Overlaps with WhatsApp and Instagram DMs

competitors.label: Inside Meta
competitors.text: WhatsApp and Instagram DMs cannibalise usage, especially under-30s

competitors.label: Messaging
competitors.text: iMessage, Google Messages (RCS), Snapchat, Telegram, Discord

competitors.label: Business chat
competitors.text: WhatsApp Business, Intercom/live chat, RCS Business Messaging

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Facebook graph, Marketplace, no phone number needed, Meta ads engine

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Slow irrelevance as Facebook ages; becomes a feature rather than a product

news.label: Jun 2026
news.text: Meta Business Agent launched for Messenger, WhatsApp and Instagram at Conversations 2026

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: messenger.com shut on 14 Apr; redirects to facebook.com/messages

news.label: Dec 2025
news.text: Messenger desktop apps for Windows and Mac retired

news.label: Watch
news.text: Full inbox merge into Facebook app, Meta AI usage, Business Agent pricing

sources: Meta Q2 2026 results, Meta announcements, DataReportal, press coverage. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
